extraction_notes: This is a procedural case-management order only. It does not decide Colombia's intervention, the merits, or any party's criminal responsibility; a human should confirm the operative wording and whether a later order changed the time-limits.
proposed_claim: The ICJ fixed time-limits for South Africa and Israel to submit written observations on Colombia's declaration of intervention in the pending Genocide Convention case.
source_title: Order of 6 June 2024, Application of the Convention on the Prevention and Punishment of the Crime of Genocide in the Gaza Strip (South Africa v. Israel)
